 Bench At Aurangabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The learned counsel for the applicant has placed on record the original Rent Agreement.

On perusal of the same, it appears that the Godown, which is the subject matter of the present crime,
has been given on rent from 29.06.2018 for near about 14 months to co-accused Arjun Aglave.
The learned APP seeks time to verify the said original rent agreement and also direct the Investigating Officer to record the statement of the witnesses on the rent agreement.
Though the applicant is having some antecedents, however, considering the original Rent Agreement placed on record, I am inclined to protect the applicant by an interim order of anticipatory bail.

2. In view of the above, until further orders, in the event of 2 5-ABA.1149-19.odt arrest of applicant PRAVIN S/O. SANJAY ZAWAR in connection with Crime No.261 of 2019 registered with Karmad Police Station, District Aurangabad for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 272, 273, 328 read with Section 34 of Indian Penal Code and under Section 59 of Food, Safety and Standards Act,
he be released on bail on his furnishing P.B. of Rs.5,000/-(Rupees Five Thousand only), with one surety of the like amount on the following conditions that :-
a] The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence in any manner.
